proposed_title: Statue of Liberty Cruise NYC: 60-Min Day or Night Tour from $19
proposed_meta_title: Statue of Liberty Cruise NYC | $19 60-Min Tour | Groupon
proposed_meta_description: 60-min NYC harbor cruise to Statue of Liberty. Day or night sailings from Pier 36. Indoor/outdoor seating. 125,000+ bought. From $19.
proposed_h1: Statue of Liberty NYC Cruise: 60-Minute Day or Night Harbor Tour
proposed_highlights: Narrated 60-minute NYC harbor cruise to within 100 feet of the Statue of Liberty
Day cruise (11 AM, 12:30 PM, 2:30 PM): See Statue of Liberty, Freedom Tower, Brooklyn Bridge, Ellis Island, Battery Park, and Governor's Island
Night cruise (4:30 PM, 6:30 PM): Sunset sailing with illuminated Statue of Liberty and NYC skyline views
Indoor and outdoor seating — boat rotates for optimal photo opportunities at Lady Liberty
Departs daily from Pier 36, Manhattan — advance purchase required, no walk-up ticket sales
Rated 4.56/5 by 10,409 Groupon customers — join 125,000+ passengers who've experienced this tour
Valid 180 days from purchase — present voucher at arrival, no reservation needed
pricing_framing: Remove or substantiate the '56% off' claim. The audit shows value_comm scored only 5/10 because 'no original price displayed anywhere on page — customers cannot verify the $19 deal represents genuine savings.' Research synthesis confirms 'original prices not captured from the page — the discount cannot be verified.' If no verifiable original price exists, reframe the price section to emphasize social proof instead of discount: display '125,000+ bought' and '4.56/5 from 10,409 reviews' immediately above or adjacent to the $19 price. Position as 'From $19 per person' rather than '56% off' to avoid unsubstantiated discount claims that erode trust.
executive_summary: The page scores 7.0/10 overall. The #1 issue is value communication (5/10): the title claims '56% off' but no original price is shown anywhere, making the discount unverifiable. Second issue: completeness (7/10) — missing weather policy, confusing '2026' availability language (AI flag), and overlapping 4:30/6:30 PM times for both cruise types. Reframing value around 125,000+ purchases and 4.56★ rating (instead of unverifiable discount), clarifying sailing schedules, and adding cancellation policy could lift conversion 10-15%.
